description: EduOpus connects your school management system with ChatGPT, allowing authorized school staff to access and manage school information using natural language. Check student records, attendance, homework, fees, payments, staff information, and other school data, and perform supported actions without navigating through multiple dashboards. Access and actions depend on the permissions available to your connected EduOpus account.

defaultPrompt: What's our fee collection status this month?
Which students haven't paid their fees this month?
Give me a quick overview of how the school is doing right now
